title: HOSA Nutrition: Medical Nutrition Therapy - Nutrition - Medical Nutrition Therapy - Dysphagia
subject: Nutrition

questions.q: A stroke patient has been diagnosed with dysphagia and is cleared for a 'Level 2: Mechanically Altered' diet. Which food item is appropriate?
options: Thin vegetable soup with large chunks
questions.explain: Mechanically altered diets require moist, soft-textured foods that are easily formed into a bolus. Ground meat with gravy is appropriate. Dry, hard, or mixed-texture foods (thin soup with chunks) are aspiration risks.
